reviews.title: You have to purchase everything!
reviews.text:
Only one out of the sixteen games is free. To be completely Frank? It's ridiculous! This game is for kids, and it shouldn't be completely locked behind a paywall. 

I can understand that it is still an appropriate game for children that might entertain them temporarily. However, it’s not as fun as it claims to be in the long run. You can only access one game, which is very basic. It gets dull and repetitive. 

I’m not saying that everything in the game needs to be free. The company needs to make money, after all. Still, I believe you would improve the app a lot by offering at least six free games. This isn’t even half of what’s available, but it would really enhance the app! Don’t waste your time on this app until they fix the excessive paywalls.

reviews.title: Terrible, not child-friendly
reviews.text:
The apps contained in this “suite” of apps were removed from the App Store, and this subscription drivel put in their place.  Luckily it looks like they are still available to download via the My Apps tab, but they are not being updated. I was excited to see this all-in-one version, so I could access my apps all in one place. As an owner of the majority of games contained in this app, I *should* be able to open and use any app that I purchased. Unfortunately that is NOT the case. The “restore” feature does nothing, and is clearly only to restore a subscription, not access to previous apps from Toca Boca. 

The endless money grab model isn’t doing it for me and I would NEVER recommend this to anybody, especially not in a school setting. It’s total garbage, and a shame that Toca Boca’s name is on it.
